description: Settlement Cost Check (Base): what moving money costs RIGHT NOW (live gas price, L1 data fee, ETH/USD from Chainlink on Base) for an x402 settlement (~86,550 gas, measured), a USDC transfer, an ETH transfer and an approval, in ETH and USD. Send amount_usd (+ payments_per_day) to learn whether a payment that small is worth settling on its own: SETTLE / BATCH_OR_CREDITS / DONT_SETTLE_SINGLY, the overhead %, break-even payment size, and cheaper options (CDP free tier, Circle Gateway batching, prepaid credits). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/settlement-cost, $0.002 via x402.)
